text: You don't need 1.1 as a subsection if you only have one subsection in 1, it took too much unnecessary space. Just state your research questions and the sub-RQs
same again, if you don't have multiple sub-RQs, don't mark it as 1.1, just elaborate, basic format logic here
it's a very absolute claim, which is usually not recommended in scientific, you might try to reformulate it into "a lot of people struggle with ...."
as long as you mentioned existing approaches, you have to elaborate and put the citations next to it

If this is the direction you are going to explore in the future research, I think you might need to extend the granularity and details of your research questions, a single question can barely address such as broad object
big mistake, you have to get a basic knowledge of what an LLM-Agent is before you cite it. GPT-4 is an LLM, the authors used it to build an teaching agent
only one SOTA isn't enough, you might have to do more literature analysis, see how the progress has been made

This isn't theoretical framework. You might have to check a real paper/dissertation and see what is included in the theoretical foundation. IT's about the technology and frameworks you mentioned or designed for the experiments, what they are and why they are accepted.

you should also mention this in your methodology, how you are (approximately) going to build such an agent, if you don't know how for now, it's good to take a look at the literature of LLM Agent and have a basic plan of building one for your project

Literature analysis is usually not the methodology, methods are about experiment design, data analysis etc. Literature analysis should be done before you start to apply the methods, such as when you are writing this proposal, you should have already got a deep understanding in the existing studies, SOTA, frameworks and approaches.
Well stated, why not write some more in a separate paragraph since you still have a lot to space to utilise.
change it with your real project plan, don't copy and past
well done, you can write more like this
copy-pasted, modify it with your own word
you obviously need more literature analysis and papers regarding educational LLM-agent
After reading your whole expose, I think your research question quite focuses on the private/personalised tutoring by LLMs/-Agent, I think you should mention this aspect in your title/subtitle
More citations are needed, especially for the SOTA and theoretical foundation sections. Once you have had enough reading, you might know how to update your methodology better
